list.title: Workspaces
list.subtitle: All your spaces, by platform and by CTF.

create.title: New workspace
create.subtitle: A workspace is a platform, a CTF, or a personal challenge.

type.platformHelp: Long term: HTB, THM, Root-Me. Unlimited challenges.
type.eventHelp: Limited time: scoreboard and an end date.

details.name: Name
details.timezone: Times are in your time zone ({{zone}}).
details.lockAfterEndHelp: Prevents editing challenges and writeups after the event ends.

mode.soloHelp: Just you. You can invite guests later.
mode.teamHelp: Shared with an existing team. Permissions by role.
mode.noEligibleTeam: You must be an admin or the captain of a team to create a workspace for it.

validation.endsBeforeStart: The end must come after the start.
validation.eventUrl: Enter a full http:// or https:// address.

settings.title: Settings
settings.readOnly: Only Admins and the Captain can change these settings.
settings.archiveHint: Read-only for everyone; pending invitations are cancelled.
settings.archiveText: Nobody can edit it until it is unarchived. Pending invitations are cancelled and will not come back.
settings.unarchiveHint: Editing comes back; cancelled invitations stay cancelled.
settings.leaveHint: You lose access; only a Captain or an Admin can bring you back.
settings.deleteHint: Irreversible: its challenges, writeups and files go with it.
settings.deleteText: Everything in it is deleted for good.
settings.leaveDescription: You will lose access to this workspace and all its content. This action cannot be undone.
settings.leaveConfirm: Are you sure you want to leave this workspace?

identity.title: Identity
identity.slugHint: Set at creation; links to the workspace use it.

modeTeam.title: Mode & team
modeTeam.workspaceTypeHint: Solo: you alone. Team: shared with a team.
modeTeam.associatedTeamHint: Members and roles come from this team.

event.title: Event
event.lockAfterEndHint: Once it ends: no new challenges and no edits to their details. Notes, files, writeups and statuses stay editable.
event.autoArchiveHint: Makes the workspace read-only some days after the end.

writeupVisibility.title: Writeup visibility
writeupVisibility.defaultHint: You can always publish individually per writeup.

settings.unsavedText: Your changes on this page are lost if you leave it without saving them.

roles.title: Access
roles.label: Roles
roles.hint: Inherited from {{team}}: Captain, Admin, Member, Viewer.

source.title: Type and source
source.eventUrlHint: Public page of the CTF or platform, opened from the dashboard.

members.title: Members
members.subtitleGuest: You have access as a guest.
members.roleReset: {{name}} is back to their team role
members.excludeText: They stay on the team but lose access to this workspace. A Captain or an Admin can bring them back.
members.removeGuestText: They lose access to this workspace. Coming back takes a new invitation.
members.guestRemoved: {{name}} no longer has access to the workspace

exclusions.title: Excluded
exclusions.hint: Team members without access to this workspace, removed by a Captain or an Admin, or who left it.
exclusions.lifted: {{name}} has the access the team gives back

invitations.title: Pending invitations
invitations.hintAll: Every invitation of the workspace. The address shows only while the invitation waits.
invitations.cancelText: {{who}} will no longer be able to accept it.

invite.title: Invite to {{name}}
invite.description: Someone outside the team, as a guest. They have to accept the invitation, valid for 7 days.
invite.roleHint: A guest is at most Member. Higher roles come from the team.
invite.mailHint: A mail goes out either way. If no account has the address, they sign up and find the invitation.

notFound.title: Workspace not found
notFound.description: It does not exist, or you no longer have access to it.

archived.banner: This workspace is archived: it is read-only.

dashboard.emptyText: Challenges, their progress and the team's activity will show here.
dashboard.emptyTextReader: Challenges will show here as soon as a member creates one.
dashboard.emptyTextSolo: No challenge was created in this workspace.
dashboard.eventLinkHint: (opens the event page in a new tab)
